review:
Gangsterz is a crime-themed cluster slot with match-3 elements and refilling reels. Five or more identical symbols adjacent vertically or horizontally form a cluster.

Four identical symbols in a square merge into a 2x2 big symbol that doubles the win of any cluster it joins, and several big symbols in one win add their multipliers together. A Big Boss symbol can split into four normal symbols during a refill. The Pot feature can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 12,000x maximum and a 96.3% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 380 spins. The big-symbol merging gives it a different feel from the Potion Spells and Pop Zen games built on the same base.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 380 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
